320	No matter how much a person tries, it is beyond the grasp of
321	human
322	beings. This is what is called "all the life of this world": "One hour
323	of contentment of spirit in the World to Come is better than all the life of this world."
324	"Contentment of spirit" means you haven't yet entered Gan Eden, you only catch a bit
325	of the fragrance from outside, of what is happening
326	inside. In Jerusalem there is the Angel bakery. Whoever walks
327	by the bakery usually walks more slowly.
328	How pleasant it is there. That is called contentment of spirit. "One hour
329	of contentment of spirit in the World to Come is better than all the life of this world."
330	What is the logic? At first glance it sounds a bit exaggerated. What is
331	the logic? The logic is simple: matter, as is known, is
332	a kind of imagination. We see matter as something
333	real because that is what we perceive with our eyes. But
334	in truth, matter is a kind of imagination.
335	Even science is beginning to understand this. We know
336	that all matter is made of atoms, which are tiny particles
337	all packed tightly one next to
338	the other. On the tip of a pin, how many atoms are there at the very
339	finest point? How many atoms are there? You would have to write the number
340	three and then 15 zeros. That is the number of atoms
341	on the tip of a pin. And what is each atom made of?
342	A nucleus inside, and electrons circling around it
343	at speed, and so they create the illusion of a shell. Like a
344	fan: it has blades, but when it spins
345	fast you see a disk. The disk is an illusion. It
346	looks solid, like an atom, but it is not solid. It is only
347	the speed. Electrons move at speed
348	and create the illusion of a shell, and when there are billions
349	upon billions of them packed together, we see
350	matter. Physicists claim: what would happen if
351	the electrons stopped
352	moving? What would happen? The entire universe
353	would disappear. They claim that the real matter of the whole
354	planet Earth could fit in a matchbox. That is the real matter
355	that exists. All the rest is imagination. It is a kind
356	of imagination. Since matter is imagination, say the sages of
357	the Kabbalah, the pleasures we enjoy are also a kind of
358	imagination. In the material world, when a person enjoys, it is a kind of
359	imagination, but he enjoys it because it suits the material world.
